inventory_diagnostics.inventory_interpretation: W/U is kg/m; occupied area = sum(Wfilm/Ufilm)/rhoF + Wdrop/(Udrop*rhoF) + Wvapor/(Uvapor*rhoV). The 1e-6 tolerance tests an algebraic geometry identity, not measurement uncertainty. Physical-consistency rejection applies only where AFFNC >= 1-1e-12 (numerically unblended annular flow); absence of such nodes leaves status unknown. Common-annular mass diagnostics use a fixed downstream control volume whose upstream face and all cells satisfy this mask at every time; its residual is outflow minus inflow plus backward-Euler storage, with no storage for the initial steady state. Pre-annular values are source initialization quantities and all-region area/mass diagnostics there are descriptive, not physical-domain acceptance checks. Zero/zero inventory is indeterminate and fails if in the applicable region. Any four-field film-thickness caps do not independently enforce this inventory identity. Numerical convergence and algebraic flow partition do not establish mass-storage conservation. Source/formulation limitation versus translation error remains unresolved without MATLAB reference execution.

annular_energy_equation: Not solved upstream; film/drop H is prescribed HF. Evaporation identity and precursor enthalpy equation are checked, not independent annular energy conservation.
momentum_mask_interpretation: The raw full momentum residual is restricted by the final state's reconstructed unrelaxed candidate, thickness and AFFNC. Last point-iteration intermediate values were not recorded; finite point tolerances and sequential field updates can change the branch/force after it was tested. Thin-film force residual is a separate check, not full momentum conservation.
arrays_layout: Residuals at TIME[1:],Z[1:]; film arrays retain wall dimension; occupied area excludes inlet.
